svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: RimStudio roadmap
svg.desc: Roadmap status of 2026-10-10: 40% of the planned effort is done. M0 Skeleton 79%, M1 Core engine 94%, M2 Manager MVP 29%, M3 Manager v1 0%, M4 Toolkit foundation 44%, M5 Item designer 75%, M6 Workshop publishing 0%, M7 Polish and release 0%. Release 0.1.0: 7 of 8 checks met.
svg.text: Status of 2026-10-10. Plan: docs/roadmap.md. Data: docs/roadmap-status.json.
of the planned effort is done
weighted by size, 48 person-weeks in total
partly done or built as a temporary version
Weapons editor for ranged and melee weapons; vanilla output, optional Combat Extended patches
Weapons editor: ranged and melee, math, quiz, fit meter
Optional CE patch generator: new, convert, update, lint
JSON document store for drafts and calibration caches
CLI commands for all of it with JSON output
Fictional ranged and melee weapon: plan and files, byte equal
CE off writes no CE file; on writes gated patch files
Convert and update modes give a patch only reviewable diff

fmt, clippy and tests clean in every crate
